notes.title: The game that inspired Warframe is free on Steam until Saturday
notes.content: The multiplayer third-person shooter Warframe has been around for more than a decade, and by any measure it's a major success. It's sometimes compared to Destiny, but its roots actually go back much further, to a third-person shooter called Dark Sector that was announced in 2000 and eventually released in 2008. If you missed it back then, you can pick it up right now for free on Steam... Read more.
